def_en: 1) to cry, cry out, call, call for help
1b) (Niphal) to be assembled, be called together, be joined together
1c1) to call, call out, call together, summon
1c4) to call out to, call out at
kjv: assemble, call (together), (make a) cry (out), come with such a company, gather (together), cause to be proclaimed.
expl: to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly
